customMethods.name: flexToggle
customMethods.script:
thisflex = int(selfFlex.meta.name.replace("Section",""))
	flexcount = selfFlex.view.getChild("root").custom.flexcount
	anyVisible = False
	
	# Loop over all flex containers
	for i in range(1, flexcount+1):
	    flex = selfFlex.getSibling("FlexContainer" + str(i))
	    
	    if i == thisflex:
	        # Show the chosen one
	        flex.position.display = not flex.position.display
	        
	        if flex.position.display:
	        	selfFlex.parent.position.basis = str(int(flex.position.basis.replace("px",""))+labelsHeight)+"px"
	        	selfFlex.parent.position.shrink = 0
	        else: 
	        	selfFlex.parent.position.shrink = 1
	    else:
	        # Hide the rest
	        flex.position.display = False

config.script:
alerts.showAlert(state="warning", title="Guardar registro", message="Esta seguro de que desea guardar el registro de Inicio de turno?", 
	btnTextPrimary="Si", btnTextSecondary="No", btnActionPrimary="saveStartShift")

messageHandlers.script:
logger = system.util.getLogger('logger_santiago')
	listCustom = [
		"answers"
	]
	
	for path in listCustom:
		self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer_Start").refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))
	
	
	
	listCustom = [
		"answers.formato"
	]
	for path in listCustom:
		self.view.refreshBinding("custom.{}".format(path))

	answerIT = self.view.custom.answers.formato
	
	papoID = self.view.params.papoID
	user = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	workstationNodeID = self.view.params.workstationnodeID
	workstationID = self.view.params.workstationID
	nodeID = self.view.params.nodeID
	status = "En proceso"
	now = system.date.now()
	
	from java.lang import String
	query = """
		SELECT TOP 1 RegisterCode
		FROM registerhistory
		WHERE WorkstationNodeID=? AND PapoID=?
		ORDER BY ID DESC
	"""

	try:
		result = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, [workstationNodeID,papoID], "papo_db")
		
		regCode = result.getValueAt(0,0)
	except:
		regCode=1

	def insert_answer(registerTypeID, answerJson, regCode):
		if not answerJson:
			return
		query = """
			INSERT INTO registerhistory (
				[Timestamp],
				DataAnswer,
				Status,
				PapoID,
				RegisterTypeID,
				[User],
				WorkstationNodeID,
				NodeID,
				WorkstationID,
				RegisterCode
			)
			VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? ,?)
		"""
		
		# ⚠️ Aseguramos que sea String plano
		data_answer_str = String(answerJson)
		
		params = [
			now,
			data_answer_str,
			status,
			papoID,
			registerTypeID,
			user,
			workstationNodeID,
			nodeID,
			workstationID,
			regCode
		]
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(query, params, "papo_db")
	
	# --- Insertar directo los tres JSON ---
	insert_answer(20, system.util.jsonEncode(answerIT),regCode)  
	
	
	
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage(
	    messageType="refreshTable", 
	    payload={"estado": True,},
	    scope="session"
	)
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage(
	    messageType="closeEmbeded", 
	    payload={"estado": False,},
	    scope="session"
	)
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage(
	    messageType="refreshPeriodic", 
	    payload={"min": 0,},
	    scope="session"
	)
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshPreviewTable", payload=[], scope="session")
	
	#--------------CPP and CPK---------------------
	parent_path = self.view.custom.path1
	
	reference = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer_Start").getChild("FlexContainer1").getChild("FlexContainer1").getChild("Dropdown").props.value
	
	variables = [
		'/Espesor placas derecha/CurrentValue',
		'/Peso placas derecha/CurrentValue',
		'/Espesor placas izquierda/CurrentValue',
		'/Peso placas izquierda/CurrentValue',
		'/Porcentaje humedad/CurrentValue'
	]
	
	espe_placa_d = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer_Start").getChild("FlexContainer1").getChild("FlexContainer20").getChild("NumericEntryField_0").props.value
	peso_placa_d = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer_Start").getChild("FlexContainer1").getChild("FlexContainer18").getChild("NumericEntryField_0").props.value
	espe_placa_i = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer_Start").getChild("FlexContainer1").getChild("FlexContainer21").getChild("NumericEntryField_0").props.value
	peso_placa_i = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer_Start").getChild("FlexContainer1").getChild("FlexContainer19").getChild("NumericEntryField_0").props.value
	por_hume = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer_Start").getChild("FlexContainer1").getChild("FlexContainer6").getChild("NumericEntryField_0").props.value
	logger.info('Valores leido: {} {} {}'.format(espe_placa_d,peso_placa_d,por_hume))
	values = [espe_placa_d, peso_placa_d,espe_placa_i, peso_placa_i, por_hume]
	# === Escribir cada valor en su tag correspondiente ===
	for var, val in zip(variables, values):
		full_path = parent_path + reference + var
		logger.info('path {}'.format(full_path))
		system.tag.writeBlocking([full_path], [val])
